description: Transformer agents given an attention schema were more accurate at categorizing the attention states of other agents, had attention that others could categorize more easily, and did better in a joint painting task. The gains were specific to tasks about attention, not a general effect of added complexity.
limitations: Artificial transformer attention may differ from biological attention. A preprint, from Graziano’s group.

sources.quote: we found that an agent with an attention schema is better at categorizing the attention states of other agents (higher accuracy)
